events.title: Safari 11 released
events.summary: Apple released Safari 11 on September 19, 2017 with macOS High Sierra — adding Intelligent Tracking Prevention, autoplay blocking, and WebRTC improvements.
events.about: Safari 11's Intelligent Tracking Prevention (ITP) limited cross-site cookies — reshaping ad tech and analytics. Autoplay blocking and reader mode refinements kept Safari focused on privacy and battery life as Chrome grew on desktop.

narrative.whyChosen: Safari 11's ITP was a watershed moment for web privacy and ad tracking.
narrative.whyImportant: Browser-level tracking prevention forced the ad industry to adapt measurement strategies.
narrative.problemSolved: Third-party cookies enabled pervasive cross-site tracking without user awareness.

sources.title: Apple — macOS High Sierra available today (September 19, 2017)
